splitPolicy: No random row split. weather_single templates trained on 2018-2022; 2023-2024 template holdout. Weather multi-field summaries, missing-NDVI causal reasoning, inverse conversion and source-override instructions are task holdouts. Guide holdout uses new question templates over shared source cards, which is not novel-domain evaluation. Crop heat task/trait is held out.
description: Locally prepared supervised instruction/answer pairs grounded in existing public data and documented project sources. These are source-derived targets, not human-annotated independent agronomy judgments. No evaluation example is used for gradient updates.
